Create the homepage Open Graph image for Astra Projects.

OUTPUT
1200 × 630 PNG.
Use deterministic rendering with Next.js ImageResponse.
Do not use an AI image model.

BRAND
Use public/logo.png exactly as supplied.
Preserve its colors, proportions, dark background, and complete spiral.
Do not redraw, recolor, stretch, or add stars.

STYLE
White background: #ffffff.
Main text: #0d0d0d.
Secondary text: #5d5d5d.
Optional fine rule: #e6e6e6.
Use explicitly loaded Geist or a consistent licensed sans-serif font.
Minimal editorial composition with generous whitespace.

LAYOUT
Keep essential text at least 56 px from the edges.
Top-left: a small complete logo beside “Astra Projects”.
Left: headline and supporting copy.
Right: the complete square logo, approximately 360 × 360.
Keep text and artwork separate.

EXACT HEADLINE
See what people are
actually doing
with Astra.

SUPPORTING COPY
Real projects, experiments, useful work, and things that
didn't quite go as planned.

OPTIONAL FOOTER
Independent collection of GPT-6 Astra projects

Use large semibold typography. Measure wrapping and prevent overflow.
Do not print a project count.

No cards, pills, robots, fake UI, extra galaxies, decorative stars,
synthetic illustrations, or gradients outside the supplied artwork.

Route: /
Existing image entry point: src/app/opengraph-image.tsx
